They also said the scary 15% unsecured bond yield also overstates the capital stack because Goldman puts CoreWeave’s blended cost of debt closer to 9% with most borrowing secured by GPUs and customer contracts while managed-inference and Omni can lift revenue per MW without requiring equivalent new infrastructure.

The catch is obviously efficiency because Goldman’s model implies a roughly 3-year payback versus closer to two years for $IREN and $NBIS.

zh_summary: @StockSavvyShay 表示今天早上在黑色星期一週年時，於家庭投資組閤中加倉 $AXON，因其交易於 30 倍 EV/EBITDA 以下，接近自 2019 年以來最便宜的估值，同時持續建立 $CBRS 部位。兩者皆是接觸 AI 下一階段的方式，但理由不同：Axon 成為公共安全控制中心，將較便宜的 AI 轉為更高價值軟體，而 Cerebras 則因 AI 代理使推理速度極具價值而受益。
text:
Here's what I ended up buying this morning in my family portfolio on the anniversary of Black Monday.

I added to $AXON as it trades below 30x EV/EBITDA near its cheapest valuation since 2019 while continuing to build my $CBRS position.

Both are ways I'm gaining exposure to next phase of AI but for very different reasons with Axon becoming control center of public safety and turning cheaper AI into higher-value software while Cerebras benefits as AI agents make inference speed super valuable.

name: KawzInvests
zh_summary: @KawzInvests 詢問過去幾年有多少被炒作的 IPO 燒傷了散戶，列出 $CRWV、$CBRS、$BLSH、$FIG，甚至 $SPCX 在初始炒作後遭受重挫。指出 Nscale 據報希望約 300 億美元估值，但 $MSFT 退出英國數據中心交易，部分投資者推動 160-190 億美元，IPO 可能延遲。另提及 Anthropic 投資者討論約 1.5 兆美元，低於先前約 2 兆美元預期，建議散戶不應押注五年完美執行，應留有餘地。
text:
How many hyped IPOs have burned retail in the past couple years?

$CRWV. $CBRS. $BLSH. $FIG. Even $SPCX got hammered after the initial hype.

Now Nscale reportedly wants ~$30B, but $MSFT has pulled out of a UK data center deal and some investors are pushing for $16–19B. I wouldn’t be surprised if this IPO gets delayed.

Last week, Reuters reported some Anthropic investors were discussing a valuation closer to ~$1.5T, versus earlier expectations of ~$2T.

Retail shouldn't have to bet on five years of perfect execution just to earn a decent return.

Leave something on the table.
